BiblicalUsage: In the Old Testament, gôshem is the word for rain, to be rained upon. In Ezekiel 22:24, the text says "nor rained upon in the day of indignation."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, gôshem means rain, to be rained upon, nothing more and nothing less.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
